sloka: स हि राज गुणैः युक्तः युव राजः समीक्षितः ।अपि च अपि मया शिष्टैः कार्यम् वो भर्तृ शासनम् ॥२-४५-९॥
transliteration: sa hi rāja guṇaiḥ yuktaḥ yuva rājaḥ samīkṣitaḥ ।api ca api mayā śiṣṭaiḥ kāryam vo bhartṛ śāsanam ॥2-45-9॥

translations.english: Endowed with kingly qualities, he is recognised as heirapparent. Therefore, as I did, all of you should obey the order of the king.
